messages:
Cassie N.: quick design check 🧵 — uploaded a lean and an expanded alert preview for review: https://www.figma.com/file/new-alert-preview. Main goal: make the preview verbally useful for screenreaders while keeping the compact tile readable for ops scanning. Victor L.: skimmed both. compact tile is lovely visually but loses routing intent. suggestion: add a tiny left-aligned text summary line: 'CRIT 90% · 5m — PagerDuty > Slack (email suppressed)'. keep it single line so rows stay tight. Ivy R.: agree with Victor. SR note: long sentences in preview are noisy. prefer a short status line announced via aria-live and a separate SR-only expanded line with details. e.g., live text: 'Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; sends to PagerDuty then Slack.' detailed offscreen: 'Email delivery suppressed between 22:00 and 06:00 local time.' Rohan (eng): implementation Q: how do we surface suppressed vs delayed? designers show muted opacity — color-only. need pattern/label for non-color perception. Maybe add a tiny clock icon with 'delayed' and a slash icon for 'suppressed' with alt text. accessibility-bot: automated scan: issues detected — compact microchips contrast 3.3:1 (fail), preview aria-live missing role="status". Recommendations: raise contrast to >=4.5:1 for small text, use
for the live preview, and provide aria-describedby id for suppression details. Cassie N.: thanks — will update chips and add aria-describedby for the quiet-hours text. on copy: current label 'Silence window' confuses some users in tests; proposing 'Quiet hours (suppression window)'. shorter variant for compact: 'Quiet hours'. Victor L.: +1. small UX ask: when threshold is edited inline show an ephemeral revert action in the preview like 'Threshold 85% — Undo' accessible via keyboard. reduces accidental config fear. Ivy R.: SR markup suggestion: ```html
Preview: triggers at 90% for 5 minutes; PagerDuty then Slack.
Email suppressed between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM local time.
``` Rohan (eng): will wire up the live region and add accessible labels for icons. on the timeline pill I'll include diagonal stripes for suppressed ranges and provide text fallback. Cassie N.: great. I'll push an updated prototype with: compact summary line, aria-live role=status, suppression offscreen copy id, stronger contrast, patterned timeline, and undo toast. aim to post for final pass tomorrow. :thumbsup:
